description.zh: 用一组圆形按钮表示互斥选项，同组内只能选中一个且不可取消。 与复选框的核心区别是多选与单选；选中圆点用填充动画反馈， 选项少（2～5 个）时平铺展示比下拉选择效率更高。
description.en: A set of circular buttons for mutually exclusive options — exactly one selected per group, never unset. The core contrast with checkboxes is single versus multi selection; the dot fills with animation on select, and with 2–5 options a visible radio group beats a dropdown.

use_when.zh: 选项 2～5 个且互斥，需要一眼看全
use_when.en: 2–5 mutually exclusive options that should stay visible

use_when.zh: 默认选中项明确、无需取消选择
use_when.en: A clear default exists and unselecting is not needed

use_when.zh: 支付方式、配送方式等并列方案选择
use_when.en: Parallel plans like payment or delivery methods

avoid_when.zh: 选项多于 5 个，用下拉选择节省空间
avoid_when.en: More than 5 options — a select saves space

avoid_when.zh: 开 / 关二元即时切换，用 switch
avoid_when.en: Binary on/off toggling — use a switch

note.zh: 圆点 + 文字的经典排布
横向排布，适合密集表单

notes.zh: 自定义圆圈用 border 圆形 + 内部小圆点 scale 弹出动画；选中态整组 name 一致保证原生互斥。React 中受控 value 对比实现选中。 整行 label 可点击扩大热区；键盘上下键在组内移动（原生自带）。 卡片式用外框高亮代替圆点强调，但保留 radio 语义。
notes.en: Custom circles use a bordered ring with an inner dot scaling in; shared name keeps native exclusivity. In React, controlled value comparison drives selection. Make full rows clickable; arrow keys move within the group natively. Card styles emphasize via outer ring highlight while keeping radio semantics.

basic.zh: 创建一个单选框组件，支持默认、卡片式与行内分段三种样式。
basic.en: Create a radio group component with default, card and inline segmented styles.

design.zh: 创建单选框组件。要求：圆形框内选中圆点 scale 弹入；卡片式整卡可点、 选中时 accent 描边高亮并展示描述文案；组内互斥且始终有一项选中； 深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a radio group component. Requirements: inner dot scaling in inside a circular ring; card style fully clickable with an accent ring and description when selected; mutually exclusive with one always selected; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 RadioGroup：受控 value + onChange，选项数据驱动 （{value, label, description}）；原生 input[type=radio] 隐藏 + 自定义外观， 保留键盘行为；圆点动画 scale 0 → 1，时长乘 --demo-speed；卡片式 aria-checked + 描边切换。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind RadioGroup: controlled value + onChange with data-driven options ({value, label, description}); hide native inputs but keep their keyboard behavior; dot animation scales 0 to 1 with duration multiplied by --demo-speed; card style toggles aria-checked and ring highlight.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现单选框组件。

先检查现有表单组件与 Design Token，保持风格一致。
要求：
- 受控单选，组内互斥、始终有选中项
- 支持默认 / 卡片式两种样式
- 键盘可达（原生 radio 行为 + label 关联）
- 深浅色主题一致，动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a radio group component in the current project.

Inspect existing form components and design tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Controlled single selection, exclusive, always one selected
- Default and card styles
- Keyboard accessible (native radio behavior + label association)
- Consistent light/dark themes; animation respects prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 在互斥选项间切换，用方向键检查组内选择。
task.en: Switch mutually exclusive options and try arrow-key selection.

checks.zh: 同组只有一个当前值，标签描述选择后果。
checks.en: Keep one value per group and explain each choice.

checks.zh: 不能依赖占位说明传达组的名称。
checks.en: Give the group a visible, persistent name.
